_fields.descriptionValues: highlighted numbers from the description (values at the base/displayed level only)
_fields.specs: level-gated skill upgrades ("specialization" milestones); level = skill level that unlocks the effect
_fields.stigmaMaxLevel: site build-planner's stigma level cap (stigmaMax map); origin of the number not documented by the site
_fields.daevanionBoostNodes: daevanion board nodes that add +N skill levels to this skill

skills.name: Ambush
skills.description:
Deals 126 damage to a target within 4m. Increases damage by 30% on landing as a Back attack.

7 Stagger Gauge Damage

specs.text: Engraves 2 Insignias for 10s on landing as a Back attack
50% chance to trigger [Whirlwind Slice] on hit

skills.name: Defiance
skills.description:
Removes Stun, Knockdown, Airborne, Grab, Frost, and Fear from the caster and grants Tenacity for 5s.

skills.name: Flash Slice

skills.name: Heart Gore

skills.description:
Select a target within 20m to deal 455 damage to up to 4 enemies within 4m and inflict Stun for 3000.

1 stack: 509 damage, 3000% Stun chance
2 stacks: 564 damage, 3000% Stun chance
3 stacks: 619 damage, 3000% Stun chance
4 stacks: 673 damage, 3000% Stun chance
5 stacks: 728 damage, 3000% Stun chance
